browser.boundary: Dedicated Playwright profile persists technically but does not reuse in-app-browser sessions; providers may block automated-browser authentication. Normal Chrome is the human gate for login/OAuth/CAPTCHA. No safe supported attach from Playwright to a normal user Chrome session has been proven.
